amos-ct.title: Abdominal organs (CT, AMOS2022)
amos-ct.description: SlimFormer++ with window self-attention in encoder 1, fine-tuned for 100 epochs from the released SlimFormer++ AMOS2022 CT weights. 15 abdominal organs. Mean Dice 90.14 on the 100 AMOS2022 validation CT scans.
